product.olivetti-m6-760-s.summary: The Slim Box version of the M6 with a 66 MHz i486DX2.
product.olivetti-m6-760-s.history: The Slim Box chassis distinguishes this version from the other M6-760.
product.olivetti-m6-760-s.architecture: The chassis determines the expansion available. Its riser has 1 full-length ISA slot, one short PCI slot and one shared ISA/PCI slot.
product.olivetti-m6-760-s.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-m6-760-s.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-m6-760-s.service-guide: Olivetti, Personal Computer – Pocket Service Guide, vol. II, ch. 5
product.olivetti-m6-760-s.firmware: The revision helps identify the service BIOS. The guide lists 2.03.
